title: Natural internal Hom comparison for composite open restriction
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V an open of X, and W an open of V. Put F=restriction to V followed by localization over W [new-b2-homology-evaluation-definitions]. There is a family e(M,N):F(Hom(M,N))≅Hom(F(M),F(N)) [def-pur-sheaf-hom], natural contravariantly in M and covariantly in N: F(Hom(f,g));e(M',N')=e(M,N);Hom(F(f),F(g)).

source.place: Restriction of internal Hom; Tag 0A8X, section-hom-complexes, product terms and signed differential. Steps 1 and 2 of new-v2-homology-evaluation-restriction-diagrams.

proof.text: Apply the existing natural internal-Hom comparison for restriction to V, then map its naturality square through the over-W functor and compose with overHomObjIso_naturality for W. Functoriality and associativity give the displayed composite naturality equation.

lean.statement:
theorem openOver_internalHom_comparison (X : Scheme.{u})
    (V : X.Opens) (W : V.toScheme.Opens) :
    let F : X.Modules ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.over W) :=
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι ⋙
      SheafOfModules.overFunctor V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf W
    ∃ e : ∀ M N : X.Modules,
      F.obj (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) M N) ≅
        SheafOfModules.homObj (R := V.toScheme.sheaf.over W) (F.obj M) (F.obj N),
      ∀ (M M' N N' : X.Modules) (f : M' ⟶ M) (g : N ⟶ N'),
        F.map (SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := X.sheaf) f g) ≫ (e M' N').hom =
          (e M N).hom ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := V.toScheme.sheaf.over W)
            (F.map f) (F.map g)
